chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Safwan from 'Abdullah ibn Muskhan from Ibrahim ibn Maymun from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding a man who converts to Islam and wishes to circumcise, while Hajj is approaching: Does he perform Hajj or does he circumcise? He said: 'He does not perform Hajj until he circumcises.'
ai.seo_question: Does a new Muslim convert need to circumcise before performing Hajj?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the procedural priority for a newly converted male who has not yet been circumcised, ruling that he must complete circumcision before performing Hajj. This establishes circumcision not merely as a sunnah but as a necessary condition for the validity or completeness of the pilgrimage rites for new converts, reflecting the integration of physical purity with ritual obligation in Shia fiqh. The ruling underscores the practical application of *taharah* (purity) as a prerequisite for entering the sacred state of *ihram* and performing the tawaf.
